_comment: BSData lag corrections for the 10th edition Wahapedia codex. Layered into load_catalog BETWEEN the BSData base and overrides.json (see code/bsdata/loader.py:load_catalog docstring). Each entry restores a canonical codex value that BSData's main branch still carries at the pre-errata value. Distinct from overrides.json which holds SwegHammer hand-tuning / proxies. When a BSData refresh fixes a corrected value upstream, the entry here can be retired by checking that bsdata_was no longer matches the parsed value.

aeldari_craftworlds_corsair_voidscarred.errata: BSData mapper attributed Anti-Infantry 2+ to the wrong weapon profile. Sim's primary weapon for this unit is Shuriken Pistol (Strength 4, AP -1, Damage 1), which on the current Wahapedia datasheet has only [ASSAULT] and [PISTOL] keywords. The Anti-Infantry 2+ in the BSData parse appears to have leaked from the Executioner profile (which legitimately carries Anti-Infantry 2+) onto the Shuriken Pistol entry. Since the sim's recorded weapon name and stats match the Shuriken Pistol, the corrective action is to clear anti_keywords on that profile.
aeldari_craftworlds_corsair_voidscarred.notes: Verified weapons on the Wahapedia Voidscarred datasheet: Shuriken Pistol (no anti-keyword), Neuro Disruptor (Anti-Infantry 2+), Executioner (Anti-Infantry 2+, Psychic). Kharseth's Dread of the Deep Void, Troupe Master's Neuro Disruptor secondary, and Shadowseer's Neuro Disruptor all legitimately retain Anti-Infantry 2+ per current codex and need no correction.

_audit_log.action: Added 8 Dark Angels BSData-lag corrections for missing invulnerable saves
_audit_log.evidence: Audited 8 load-bearing Dark Angels units (Azrael, Belial, Sammael, Asmodai, Lion El'Jonson, Deathwing Knights, Ravenwing Black Knights, Ezekiel) against Wahapedia 10e datasheets. All 8 have invuln_save=7 (no invuln) in BSData parsed.json. The Dark Angels catalogue (Imperium - Dark Angels.cat.gz) encodes invulnerable saves as inline <profile typeName="Abilities"> elements with a Description characteristic â€” the same structural pattern as the Chaos Daemons Library batch from wave-47 CODEX-STALE-DAEMONS. mapper.extract_invuln() only walks infoLinks and entryLink chains, missing the inline-profile encoding entirely. Wahapedia confirms: Azrael 4+, Belial 4+, Sammael 4+, Asmodai 4+, Ezekiel 4+, Deathwing Knights 4+, Lion El'Jonson 3+ (The Emperor's Shield), Ravenwing Black Knights 5+. No overrides.json entries for Dark Angels exist, so no shadow-removal needed (mirrors Karanak fix is not applicable here). Wahapedia DNS resolved successfully from worktree.

_audit_log.action: Added 1 Deathwatch correction for unparsed invulnerable save
_audit_log.evidence: Audited 5 Deathwatch-unique tournament-relevant units (Watch Master, Deathwatch Veterans, Corvus Blackstar, Indomitor Kill Team, Proteus Kill Team). Proteus Kill Team only exists as a Legends entry under Agents of the Imperium and was skipped. Wahapedia hosts current Deathwatch datasheets under imperial-agents (no deathwatch faction page). Veterans, Corvus Blackstar and Indomitor Kill Team weapon stats matched Wahapedia within basket-blend tolerance. Wahapedia confirms 4+ invuln in current codex.

_audit_log.action: Added Shape 3 to extract_fnp; corrected 2 wrong test assertions; retired 27 redundant fnp=7 overrides from overrides.json
_audit_log.evidence: Investigated the two failing tests (aeldari_drukhari_wracks and space_wolves_wulfen expecting feel no pain 5). Root-cause trace: (1) BSData v10.6.0 carried direct feel no pain infoLinks on both units; BSData main removed those infoLinks in a refactoring. (2) The old extract_fnp prose walk (pre-MAP-2) found feel no pain 5 for Wracks via a false-positive path through the Drukhari Crusade entryLink into the Ascendant Lord selectionEntryGroup, and for Wulfen via the 'Lone Wolf Battle Scars' Crusade battle honour upgrade. (3) Wahapedia 10e datasheets confirm neither unit has feel no pain as a base stat: Wracks have conditional feel no pain via Power from Pain (Pain token mechanic, already modelled at runtime in code/units.py), and Wulfen's BSData v10.6.0 'Death Frenzy' ability was renamed 'Savage Frenzy' in main without re-adding the feel no pain infoLink. Tests corrected to expect fnp=7. The 27 retired overrides were all fnp=7 suppression patches added at SC5-8/SC5-10 to fix prose-walk false positives; the MAP-2 fix (1927b99) correctly pruned upgrade subtrees, making those overrides redundant where the mapper now returns 7 natively. The 6 partial retirements (fnp field removed but entry kept for base-shape or secondary-weapon data) were verified safe: all 6 show fnp=7 in post-fix parsed.json.
_audit_log.shape_added: extract_fnp Shape 3: inline <profile typeName='Abilities'> on the unit whose name starts with 'feel no pain' and whose Description characteristic contains 'Feel No Pain N+'. Analogous to extract_invuln Shape 3 from MAPPER-INVULN-PROSE-WALK. No units currently use this shape in BSData; added as forward-compatibility for the encoding.
_audit_log.new_false_positives: none — Shape 3 fires only on profiles named 'Feel No Pain *', which no current BSData unit carries; the old prose walk false positives for Wracks/Wulfen were from Crusade content and were already suppressed by overrides.json.
